subject.title: fix(ci): enforce plugin SDK API baseline

question: Should this new CI contract check preserve historical-target validation and run for baseline-only manifest updates before it becomes a required ordinary-CI shard?
rationale: The check is valuable, but choosing its compatibility behavior and its changed-files routing is CI policy with upgrade and automation consequences beyond a mechanical test assertion.

options.title: Preserve compatibility and complete routing
options.body: Gate or skip the check only for historical targets that cannot provide the script, and route baseline-only manifest changes through the API validation.

options.title: Intentionally require current scripts everywhere
options.body: Accept historical-target validation failures and document that those runs are no longer supported for this shard.

options.title: Pause the shard addition
options.body: Keep the baseline repair on main but defer ordinary-CI enforcement until the workflow policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility and complete routing
recommendation.body: Gate or skip the check only for historical targets that cannot provide the script, and route baseline-only manifest changes through the API validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged-history evidence connects this contributor to the affected Plugin SDK baseline and config-surface changes as well as the proposed CI guard.
